name: Example: finish by 07:00
description: Starts at 06:00 and must be done by 07:00. Two searches build a morning report of yesterday's skipped scheduled searches. If the run is still going at 07:00 it is late: the whole-job Is late line sends an email, and the run carries on.

steps.name: Skipped scheduled searches
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=skipped
| stats count BY savedsearch_name, reason
| sort - count

steps.name: Morning report
steps.spl: | stats sum(count) AS skipped, dc(savedsearch_name) AS searches
